CREATE TABLE carts (
    id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    user_id uuid,
    guest_token character varying(64),
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_carts PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE categories (
    id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    name character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    slug character varying(120) NOT NULL,
    icon character varying(50),
    parent_id integer,
    sort_order integer NOT NULL,
    is_active boolean NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_categories PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_categories_categories_parent_id FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);

CREATE TABLE discounts (
    id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    code character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    title character varying(150) NOT NULL,
    percent smallint NOT NULL,
    max_amount bigint,
    min_order_amount bigint NOT NULL,
    usage_limit integer,
    used_count integer NOT NULL,
    expire_at timestamp with time zone,
    is_active boolean NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_discounts PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE site_messages (
    id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    full_name character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    email character varying(150) NOT NULL,
    subject character varying(150) NOT NULL,
    body character varying(2000) NOT NULL,
    is_read boolean NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_site_messages PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE site_settings (
    id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    store_name character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    tagline character varying(200),
    logo_url character varying(300),
    primary_color character varying(9) NOT NULL,
    support_phone character varying(20) NOT NULL,
    email character varying(150) NOT NULL,
    address text,
    instagram_url character varying(300),
    telegram_url character varying(300),
    about_us text,
    contact_us text,
    shipping_post_cost bigint NOT NULL,
    shipping_express_cost bigint NOT NULL,
    free_shipping_threshold bigint NOT NULL,
    reservation_minutes integer NOT NULL,
    max_quantity_per_product integer NOT NULL,
    low_stock_threshold integer NOT NULL,
    reservation_cleanup_interval_seconds integer NOT NULL,
    payment_gateway character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    is_maintenance_mode boolean NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_site_settings PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE sliders (
    id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    title character varying(150) NOT NULL,
    sub_title character varying(250),
    image character varying(300) NOT NULL,
    link character varying(300),
    theme character varying(20),
    sort_order integer NOT NULL,
    is_active boolean NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_sliders PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE products (
    id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    name character varying(200) NOT NULL,
    english_name character varying(200) NOT NULL,
    slug character varying(220) NOT NULL,
    code character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    unit_price bigint NOT NULL,
    discount_percent smallint NOT NULL,
    stock integer NOT NULL,
    reserved_count integer NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL,
    category_id integer NOT NULL,
    main_image character varying(300) NOT NULL,
    is_amazing boolean NOT NULL,
    amazing_ends_at timestamp with time zone,
    is_special boolean NOT NULL,
    is_active boolean NOT NULL,
    sales_count integer NOT NULL,
    view_count bigint NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone,
    CONSTRAINT pk_products PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_products_categories_category_id FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);

CREATE TABLE cities (
    id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    name character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    state_id integer NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_cities PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_cities_states_state_id FOREIGN KEY (state_id) REFERENCES states (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE cart_items (
    id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    cart_id bigint NOT NULL,
    product_id bigint NOT NULL,
    quantity integer NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_cart_items PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_cart_items_carts_cart_id FOREIGN KEY (cart_id) REFERENCES carts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_cart_items_products_product_id FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE product_images (
    id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    url character varying(300) NOT NULL,
    alt character varying(200),
    sort_order integer NOT NULL,
    product_id bigint NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_product_images PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_product_images_products_product_id FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE users (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    first_name character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    last_name character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    mobile character varying(15),
    is_active boolean NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    state_id integer,
    city_id integer,
    address_line character varying(300),
    postal_code character varying(12),
    user_name text,
    normalized_user_name text,
    email text,
    normalized_email text,
    email_confirmed boolean NOT NULL,
    password_hash text,
    security_stamp text,
    concurrency_stamp text,
    phone_number text,
    phone_number_confirmed boolean NOT NULL,
    two_factor_enabled boolean NOT NULL,
    lockout_end timestamp with time zone,
    lockout_enabled boolean NOT NULL,
    access_failed_count integer NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_users PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_users_cities_city_id FOREIGN KEY (city_id) REFERENCES cities (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    CONSTRAINT fk_users_states_state_id FOREIGN KEY (state_id) REFERENCES states (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);

CREATE TABLE blogs (
    id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    title character varying(200) NOT NULL,
    slug character varying(220) NOT NULL,
    short_description character varying(500) NOT NULL,
    body text NOT NULL,
    cover_image character varying(300) NOT NULL,
    is_visible boolean NOT NULL,
    view_count bigint NOT NULL,
    author_id uuid NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_blogs PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_blogs_users_author_id FOREIGN KEY (author_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE comments (
    id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    product_id bigint NOT NULL,
    user_id uuid NOT NULL,
    rating smallint NOT NULL,
    text character varying(2000) NOT NULL,
    is_approved boolean NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_comments PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_comments_products_product_id FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_comments_users_user_id FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE favorites (
    id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    user_id uuid NOT NULL,
    product_id bigint NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_favorites PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_favorites_products_product_id FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_favorites_users_user_id FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE orders (
    id integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    order_number character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    user_id uuid NOT NULL,
    status integer NOT NULL,
    payment_method integer NOT NULL,
    shipping_method integer NOT NULL,
    subtotal bigint NOT NULL,
    discount_amount bigint NOT NULL,
    shipping_cost bigint NOT NULL,
    total bigint NOT NULL,
    discount_code character varying(50),
    receiver_name character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    phone character varying(15) NOT NULL,
    state_id integer NOT NULL,
    city_id integer NOT NULL,
    address character varying(500) NOT NULL,
    postal_code character varying(12),
    note character varying(500),
    cancel_reason character varying(400),
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    paid_at timestamp with time zone,
    shipped_at timestamp with time zone,
    CONSTRAINT pk_orders PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_orders_cities_city_id FOREIGN KEY (city_id) REFERENCES cities (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    CONSTRAINT fk_orders_states_state_id FOREIGN KEY (state_id) REFERENCES states (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    CONSTRAINT fk_orders_users_user_id FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);

CREATE TABLE blog_comments (
    id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    blog_id integer NOT NULL,
    full_name character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    text character varying(2000) NOT NULL,
    is_approved boolean NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_blog_comments PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_blog_comments_blogs_blog_id FOREIGN KEY (blog_id) REFERENCES blogs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CREATE TABLE order_items (
    id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    order_id integer NOT NULL,
    product_id bigint NOT NULL,

    unit_price bigint NOT NULL,
    discount_percent smallint NOT NULL,
    quantity integer NOT NULL,

commandText:
SELECT count(*)::int
FROM products AS p
WHERE p.is_active AND (p.name ILIKE @Format ESCAPE '' OR p.english_name ILIKE @Format ESCAPE '')

SELECT p0.id AS "Id", p0.name AS "Name", p0.english_name AS "EnglishName", p0.slug AS "Slug", p0.main_image AS "Image", p0.unit_price AS "UnitPrice", CASE
    WHEN p0.discount_percent > 0 THEN p0.unit_price - (p0.unit_price * p0.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
    ELSE p0.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p0.stock - p0.reserved_count AS "Stock", p0.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p0.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p0.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p0.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c0
        WHERE p0.id = c0.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)
        FROM comments AS c1
        WHERE p0.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0
END AS "AverageRating", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c2
    WHERE p0.id = c2.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p0.sales_count AS "SalesCount"
FROM (
    SELECT p.id, p.amazing_ends_at, p.category_id, p.discount_percent, p.english_name, p.is_amazing, p.is_special, p.main_image, p.name, p.reserved_count, p.sales_count, p.slug, p.stock, p.unit_price
    FROM products AS p
    WHERE p.is_active AND (p.name ILIKE @Format ESCAPE '' OR p.english_name ILIKE @Format ESCAPE '')
    ORDER BY p.id DESC
    LIMIT @p5 OFFSET @p
) AS p0
INNER JOIN categories AS c ON p0.category_id = c.id

FROM site_settings AS s
ORDER BY s.id
LIMIT 1

SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (

    FROM stock_reservations

    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

SELECT count(*)::int
FROM products AS p
WHERE p.is_active AND (p.name ILIKE @Format ESCAPE '' OR p.english_name ILIKE @Format ESCAPE '')

SELECT p0.id AS "Id", p0.name AS "Name", p0.english_name AS "EnglishName", p0.slug AS "Slug", p0.main_image AS "Image", p0.unit_price AS "UnitPrice", CASE
    WHEN p0.discount_percent > 0 THEN p0.unit_price - (p0.unit_price * p0.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
    ELSE p0.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p0.stock - p0.reserved_count AS "Stock", p0.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p0.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p0.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p0.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c0
        WHERE p0.id = c0.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)
        FROM comments AS c1

SELECT p.id AS "Id", p.name AS "Name", p.english_name AS "EnglishName", p.slug AS "Slug", p.main_image AS "Image", p.unit_price AS "UnitPrice", CASE
    WHEN p.discount_percent > 0 THEN p.unit_price - (p.unit_price * p.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
    ELSE p.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p.stock - p.reserved_count AS "Stock", p.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c0
        WHERE p.id = c0.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)
        FROM comments AS c1
        WHERE p.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0
END AS "AverageRating", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c2
    WHERE p.id = c2.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p.sales_count AS "SalesCount"
FROM products AS p
INNER JOIN categories AS c ON p.category_id = c.id
WHERE p.is_active AND p.slug = @slug
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.id, s.english_name, s.code, s.description, s.view_count, s.category_id, s.parent_id, s.c, s.c0, s.id0, s.id1, p0.url, p0.id
FROM (
    SELECT p.id, p.english_name, p.code, p.description, p.view_count, p.category_id, c.parent_id, CASE
        WHEN c0.id IS NOT NULL THEN c0.name
        ELSE c.name
    END AS c, CASE
        WHEN c0.id IS NOT NULL THEN c0.slug
        ELSE c.slug
    END AS c0, c.id AS id0, c0.id AS id1
    FROM products AS p
    INNER JOIN categories AS c ON p.category_id = c.id
    LEFT JOIN categories AS c0 ON c.parent_id = c0.id
    WHERE p.slug = @slug
    LIMIT 1
) AS s
LEFT JOIN product_images AS p0 ON s.id = p0.product_id
ORDER BY s.id, s.id0, s.id1, p0.sort_order

SELECT p0.id AS "Id", p0.name AS "Name", p0.english_name AS "EnglishName", p0.slug AS "Slug", p0.main_image AS "Image", p0.unit_price AS "UnitPrice", CASE
    WHEN p0.discount_percent > 0 THEN p0.unit_price - (p0.unit_price * p0.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
    ELSE p0.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p0.stock - p0.reserved_count AS "Stock", p0.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p0.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p0.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p0.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c0
        WHERE p0.id = c0.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)
        FROM comments AS c1
        WHERE p0.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0
END AS "AverageRating", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c2
    WHERE p0.id = c2.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p0.sales_count AS "SalesCount"
FROM (

SELECT s0.id, s0.order_number, s0.status, s0.c, s0.c0, s0.subtotal, s0.discount_amount, s0.shipping_cost, s0.total, s0.discount_code, s0.receiver_name, s0.phone, s0.name, s0.name0, s0.address, s0.postal_code, s0.note, s0.created_at, s0.paid_at, s0.id0, s0.id1, s1."ProductId", s1."ProductName", s1."Slug", s1."Image", s1."UnitPrice", s1."DiscountPercent", s1."Quantity", s1."LineTotal", s1.id, s1.id0
FROM (
    SELECT o.id, o.order_number, o.status, CASE
        WHEN o.payment_method = 1 THEN 'پرداخت اینترنتی'
        ELSE 'پرداخت در محل'
    END AS c, CASE
        WHEN o.shipping_method = 2 THEN 'ارسال اکسپرس'
        ELSE 'ارسال با پست'
    END AS c0, o.subtotal, o.discount_amount, o.shipping_cost, o.total, o.discount_code, o.receiver_name, o.phone, s.name, c.name AS name0, o.address, o.postal_code, o.note, o.created_at, o.paid_at, s.id AS id0, c.id AS id1
    FROM orders AS o
    INNER JOIN states AS s ON o.state_id = s.id
    INNER JOIN cities AS c ON o.city_id = c.id
    WHERE o.id = @orderId
    LIMIT 1
) AS s0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT o0.product_id AS "ProductId", o0.product_name AS "ProductName", p.slug AS "Slug", o0.product_image AS "Image", o0.unit_price AS "UnitPrice", o0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", o0.quantity AS "Quantity", o0.unit_price * o0.quantity::bigint AS "LineTotal", o0.id, p.id AS id0, o0.order_id
    FROM order_items AS o0
    INNER JOIN products AS p ON o0.product_id = p.id
) AS s1 ON s0.id = s1.order_id
ORDER BY s0.id, s0.id0, s0.id1, s1.id

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

FROM (
    SELECT o.id, o.order_number, o.status, CASE
        WHEN o.payment_method = 1 THEN 'پرداخت اینترنتی'
        ELSE 'پرداخت در محل'
    END AS c, CASE
        WHEN o.shipping_method = 2 THEN 'ارسال اکسپرس'

    FROM orders AS o
    INNER JOIN states AS s ON o.state_id = s.id
    INNER JOIN cities AS c ON o.city_id = c.id
    WHERE o.id = @orderId
    LIMIT 1
) AS s0

    SELECT o0.product_id AS "ProductId", o0.product_name AS "ProductName", p.slug AS "Slug", o0.product_image AS "Image", o0.unit_price AS "UnitPrice", o0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", o0.quantity AS "Quantity", o0.unit_price * o0.quantity::bigint AS "LineTotal", o0.id, p.id AS id0, o0.order_id

    INNER JOIN products AS p ON o0.product_id = p.id
) AS s1 ON s0.id = s1.order_id
ORDER BY s0.id, s0.id0, s0.id1, s1.id

UPDATE products p
               SET stock = p.stock + r.quantity,
                   sales_count = GREATEST(p.sales_count - r.quantity, 0)
               FROM stock_reservations r
               WHERE r.product_id = p.id
                 AND r.order_id = @p0
                 AND r.status = 2

UPDATE stock_reservations
               SET status = 3, released_at = now()
               WHERE order_id = @p0 AND status IN (1, 2)

UPDATE orders SET status = @p0
WHERE id = @p1;

SELECT s.reservation_cleanup_interval_seconds
FROM site_settings AS s
ORDER BY s.id
LIMIT 1

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

FROM site_settings AS s
ORDER BY s.id
LIMIT 1

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

    WHEN p0.discount_percent > 0 THEN p0.unit_price - (p0.unit_price * p0.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
    ELSE p0.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p0.stock - p0.reserved_count AS "Stock", p0.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p0.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p0.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p0.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", CASE

        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c0
        WHERE p0.id = c0.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)
        FROM comments AS c1
        WHERE p0.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0
END AS "AverageRating", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c2
    WHERE p0.id = c2.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p0.sales_count AS "SalesCount", CASE

        SELECT 1
        FROM seller_offers AS s
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s0 ON s.seller_id = s0.id
        WHERE p0.id = s.product_id AND s.is_active AND s0.status = 2 AND s0.is_active AND s.stock - s.reserved_count > 0) THEN (
        SELECT min(CASE
            WHEN s1.discount_percent > 0 THEN s1.price - (s1.price * s1.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
            ELSE s1.price
        END)
        FROM seller_offers AS s1
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s2 ON s1.seller_id = s2.id
        WHERE p0.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)

    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM seller_offers AS s3

FROM (
    SELECT p.id, p.amazing_ends_at, p.category_id, p.discount_percent, p.english_name, p.is_amazing, p.is_special, p.main_image, p.name, p.reserved_count, p.sales_count, p.slug, p.stock, p.unit_price

    LIMIT @p
) AS p0
INNER JOIN categories AS c ON p0.category_id = c.id
ORDER BY p0.discount_percent DESC

commandText:
SELECT count(*)::int
FROM products AS p
WHERE p.is_active

SELECT p0.id AS "Id", p0.name AS "Name", p0.english_name AS "EnglishName", p0.slug AS "Slug", p0.main_image AS "Image", p0.unit_price AS "UnitPrice", CASE
    WHEN p0.discount_percent > 0 THEN p0.unit_price - (p0.unit_price * p0.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
    ELSE p0.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p0.stock - p0.reserved_count AS "Stock", p0.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p0.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p0.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p0.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c0
        WHERE p0.id = c0.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)
        FROM comments AS c1
        WHERE p0.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0
END AS "AverageRating", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c2
    WHERE p0.id = c2.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p0.sales_count AS "SalesCount", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM seller_offers AS s
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s0 ON s.seller_id = s0.id
        WHERE p0.id = s.product_id AND s.is_active AND s0.status = 2 AND s0.is_active AND s.stock - s.reserved_count > 0) THEN (
        SELECT min(CASE
            WHEN s1.discount_percent > 0 THEN s1.price - (s1.price * s1.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
            ELSE s1.price
        END)
        FROM seller_offers AS s1
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s2 ON s1.seller_id = s2.id
        WHERE p0.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)
END AS "MinOfferPrice", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM seller_offers AS s3
    INNER JOIN sellers AS s4 ON s3.seller_id = s4.id
    WHERE p0.id = s3.product_id AND s3.is_active AND s4.status = 2 AND s4.is_active AND s3.stock - s3.reserved_count > 0) AS "OfferCount"
FROM (
    SELECT p.id, p.amazing_ends_at, p.category_id, p.discount_percent, p.english_name, p.is_amazing, p.is_special, p.main_image, p.name, p.reserved_count, p.sales_count, p.slug, p.stock, p.unit_price, CASE
        WHEN p.discount_percent > 0 THEN p.unit_price - (p.unit_price * p.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
        ELSE p.unit_price
    END AS c
    FROM products AS p
    WHERE p.is_active
    ORDER BY CASE
        WHEN p.discount_percent > 0 THEN p.unit_price - (p.unit_price * p.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
        ELSE p.unit_price
    END
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS p0
INNER JOIN categories AS c ON p0.category_id = c.id
ORDER BY p0.c

    GROUP BY product_id

) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

) r

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

SELECT s.id, s.about_us, s.address, s.contact_us, s.email, s.free_shipping_threshold, s.instagram_url, s.is_maintenance_mode, s.logo_url, s.low_stock_threshold, s.max_quantity_per_product, s.payment_gateway, s.payment_merchant_id, s.payment_sandbox, s.primary_color, s.reservation_cleanup_interval_seconds, s.reservation_minutes, s.shipping_express_cost, s.shipping_post_cost, s.store_name, s.support_phone, s.tagline, s.tax_percent, s.telegram_url
FROM site_settings AS s
LIMIT 1

SELECT p0.id AS "Id", p0.name AS "Name", p0.english_name AS "EnglishName", p0.slug AS "Slug", p0.main_image AS "Image", p0.unit_price AS "UnitPrice", CASE
    WHEN p0.discount_percent > 0 THEN p0.unit_price - (p0.unit_price * p0.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
    ELSE p0.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p0.stock - p0.reserved_count AS "Stock", p0.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p0.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p0.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p0.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c0
        WHERE p0.id = c0.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)
        FROM comments AS c1
        WHERE p0.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0
END AS "AverageRating", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c2
    WHERE p0.id = c2.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p0.sales_count AS "SalesCount", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM seller_offers AS s
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s0 ON s.seller_id = s0.id
        WHERE p0.id = s.product_id AND s.is_active AND s0.status = 2 AND s0.is_active AND s.stock - s.reserved_count > 0) THEN (
        SELECT min(CASE
            WHEN s1.discount_percent > 0 THEN s1.price - (s1.price * s1.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
            ELSE s1.price
        END)
        FROM seller_offers AS s1
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s2 ON s1.seller_id = s2.id
        WHERE p0.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)
END AS "MinOfferPrice", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM seller_offers AS s3
    INNER JOIN sellers AS s4 ON s3.seller_id = s4.id
    WHERE p0.id = s3.product_id AND s3.is_active AND s4.status = 2 AND s4.is_active AND s3.stock - s3.reserved_count > 0) AS "OfferCount"
FROM (
    SELECT p.id, p.amazing_ends_at, p.category_id, p.discount_percent, p.english_name, p.is_amazing, p.is_special, p.main_image, p.name, p.reserved_count, p.sales_count, p.slug, p.stock, p.unit_price
    FROM products AS p
    WHERE p.is_active AND p.is_amazing AND p.stock - p.reserved_count > 0 AND p.discount_percent > 0
    ORDER BY p.discount_percent DESC
    LIMIT @p
) AS p0
INNER JOIN categories AS c ON p0.category_id = c.id
ORDER BY p0.discount_percent DESC

FROM sliders AS s

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

    GROUP BY product_id

FROM (

FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

    WHEN p0.discount_percent > 0 THEN p0.unit_price - (p0.unit_price * p0.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
    ELSE p0.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p0.stock - p0.reserved_count AS "Stock", p0.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p0.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p0.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p0.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c0
        WHERE p0.id = c0.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)
        FROM comments AS c1
        WHERE p0.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0
END AS "AverageRating", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c2
    WHERE p0.id = c2.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p0.sales_count AS "SalesCount", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM seller_offers AS s
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s0 ON s.seller_id = s0.id
        WHERE p0.id = s.product_id AND s.is_active AND s0.status = 2 AND s0.is_active AND s.stock - s.reserved_count > 0) THEN (
        SELECT min(CASE
            WHEN s1.discount_percent > 0 THEN s1.price - (s1.price * s1.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
            ELSE s1.price
        END)
        FROM seller_offers AS s1
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s2 ON s1.seller_id = s2.id
        WHERE p0.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)

    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM seller_offers AS s3

FROM (

    ORDER BY p.id DESC

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c0
        WHERE p0.id = c0.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)
        FROM comments AS c1
        WHERE p0.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0
END AS "AverageRating", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c2

    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM seller_offers AS s
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s0 ON s.seller_id = s0.id
        WHERE p0.id = s.product_id AND s.is_active AND s0.status = 2 AND s0.is_active AND s.stock - s.reserved_count > 0) THEN (
        SELECT min(CASE
            WHEN s1.discount_percent > 0 THEN s1.price - (s1.price * s1.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
            ELSE s1.price
        END)
        FROM seller_offers AS s1
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s2 ON s1.seller_id = s2.id
        WHERE p0.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)
END AS "MinOfferPrice", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM seller_offers AS s3
    INNER JOIN sellers AS s4 ON s3.seller_id = s4.id
    WHERE p0.id = s3.product_id AND s3.is_active AND s4.status = 2 AND s4.is_active AND s3.stock - s3.reserved_count > 0) AS "OfferCount"
FROM (
    SELECT p.id, p.amazing_ends_at, p.category_id, p.discount_percent, p.english_name, p.is_amazing, p.is_special, p.main_image, p.name, p.reserved_count, p.sales_count, p.slug, p.stock, p.unit_price

    WHERE p.is_active AND p.is_amazing AND p.stock - p.reserved_count > 0 AND p.discount_percent > 0

    LIMIT @p
) AS p0
INNER JOIN categories AS c ON p0.category_id = c.id
ORDER BY p0.discount_percent DESC

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

SELECT p0.id AS "Id", p0.name AS "Name", p0.english_name AS "EnglishName", p0.slug AS "Slug", p0.main_image AS "Image", p0.unit_price AS "UnitPrice", CASE
    WHEN p0.discount_percent > 0 THEN p0.unit_price - (p0.unit_price * p0.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
    ELSE p0.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p0.stock - p0.reserved_count AS "Stock", p0.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p0.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p0.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p0.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c0
        WHERE p0.id = c0.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)
        FROM comments AS c1
        WHERE p0.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0
END AS "AverageRating", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c2
    WHERE p0.id = c2.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p0.sales_count AS "SalesCount", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM seller_offers AS s
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s0 ON s.seller_id = s0.id
        WHERE p0.id = s.product_id AND s.is_active AND s0.status = 2 AND s0.is_active AND s.stock - s.reserved_count > 0) THEN (
        SELECT min(CASE
            WHEN s1.discount_percent > 0 THEN s1.price - (s1.price * s1.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
            ELSE s1.price
        END)
        FROM seller_offers AS s1
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s2 ON s1.seller_id = s2.id
        WHERE p0.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)
END AS "MinOfferPrice", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM seller_offers AS s3
    INNER JOIN sellers AS s4 ON s3.seller_id = s4.id
    WHERE p0.id = s3.product_id AND s3.is_active AND s4.status = 2 AND s4.is_active AND s3.stock - s3.reserved_count > 0) AS "OfferCount"
FROM (
    SELECT p.id, p.amazing_ends_at, p.category_id, p.discount_percent, p.english_name, p.is_amazing, p.is_special, p.main_image, p.name, p.reserved_count, p.sales_count, p.slug, p.stock, p.unit_price
    FROM products AS p
    WHERE p.is_active AND p.is_amazing AND p.stock - p.reserved_count > 0 AND p.discount_percent > 0
    ORDER BY p.discount_percent DESC
    LIMIT @p
) AS p0
INNER JOIN categories AS c ON p0.category_id = c.id
ORDER BY p0.discount_percent DESC

    WHEN p0.discount_percent > 0 THEN p0.unit_price - (p0.unit_price * p0.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
    ELSE p0.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p0.stock - p0.reserved_count AS "Stock", p0.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p0.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p0.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p0.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c0
        WHERE p0.id = c0.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)
        FROM comments AS c1
        WHERE p0.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0
END AS "AverageRating", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c2
    WHERE p0.id = c2.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p0.sales_count AS "SalesCount", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM seller_offers AS s
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s0 ON s.seller_id = s0.id
        WHERE p0.id = s.product_id AND s.is_active AND s0.status = 2 AND s0.is_active AND s.stock - s.reserved_count > 0) THEN (
        SELECT min(CASE
            WHEN s1.discount_percent > 0 THEN s1.price - (s1.price * s1.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
            ELSE s1.price
        END)
        FROM seller_offers AS s1
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s2 ON s1.seller_id = s2.id
        WHERE p0.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)
END AS "MinOfferPrice", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM seller_offers AS s3
    INNER JOIN sellers AS s4 ON s3.seller_id = s4.id
    WHERE p0.id = s3.product_id AND s3.is_active AND s4.status = 2 AND s4.is_active AND s3.stock - s3.reserved_count > 0) AS "OfferCount"
FROM (
    SELECT p.id, p.amazing_ends_at, p.category_id, p.discount_percent, p.english_name, p.is_amazing, p.is_special, p.main_image, p.name, p.reserved_count, p.sales_count, p.slug, p.stock, p.unit_price
    FROM products AS p
    WHERE p.is_active AND p.is_amazing AND p.stock - p.reserved_count > 0 AND p.discount_percent > 0
    ORDER BY p.discount_percent DESC
    LIMIT @p
) AS p0
INNER JOIN categories AS c ON p0.category_id = c.id
ORDER BY p0.discount_percent DESC

    WHERE p0.id = s3.product_id AND s3.is_active AND s4.status = 2 AND s4.is_active AND s3.stock - s3.reserved_count > 0) AS "OfferCount"

SELECT p0.id AS "Id", p0.name AS "Name", p0.english_name AS "EnglishName", p0.slug AS "Slug", p0.main_image AS "Image", p0.unit_price AS "UnitPrice", CASE
    WHEN p0.discount_percent > 0 THEN p0.unit_price - (p0.unit_price * p0.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
    ELSE p0.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p0.stock - p0.reserved_count AS "Stock", p0.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p0.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p0.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p0.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c0
        WHERE p0.id = c0.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)
        FROM comments AS c1
        WHERE p0.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0
END AS "AverageRating", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c2
    WHERE p0.id = c2.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p0.sales_count AS "SalesCount", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM seller_offers AS s
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s0 ON s.seller_id = s0.id
        WHERE p0.id = s.product_id AND s.is_active AND s0.status = 2 AND s0.is_active AND s.stock - s.reserved_count > 0) THEN (
        SELECT min(CASE
            WHEN s1.discount_percent > 0 THEN s1.price - (s1.price * s1.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
            ELSE s1.price
        END)
        FROM seller_offers AS s1
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s2 ON s1.seller_id = s2.id
        WHERE p0.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)
END AS "MinOfferPrice", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM seller_offers AS s3
    INNER JOIN sellers AS s4 ON s3.seller_id = s4.id
    WHERE p0.id = s3.product_id AND s3.is_active AND s4.status = 2 AND s4.is_active AND s3.stock - s3.reserved_count > 0) AS "OfferCount"
FROM (
    SELECT p.id, p.amazing_ends_at, p.category_id, p.discount_percent, p.english_name, p.is_amazing, p.is_special, p.main_image, p.name, p.reserved_count, p.sales_count, p.slug, p.stock, p.unit_price
    FROM products AS p
    WHERE p.is_active AND p.is_amazing AND p.stock - p.reserved_count > 0 AND p.discount_percent > 0
    ORDER BY p.discount_percent DESC
    LIMIT @p
) AS p0
INNER JOIN categories AS c ON p0.category_id = c.id
ORDER BY p0.discount_percent DESC

    ELSE p0.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p0.stock - p0.reserved_count AS "Stock", p0.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p0.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p0.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p0.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", CASE

        FROM comments AS c1
        WHERE p0.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0

    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c2
    WHERE p0.id = c2.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p0.sales_count AS "SalesCount", CASE

        SELECT 1
        FROM seller_offers AS s

        SELECT min(CASE
            WHEN s1.discount_percent > 0 THEN s1.price - (s1.price * s1.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
            ELSE s1.price
        END)
        FROM seller_offers AS s1
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s2 ON s1.seller_id = s2.id
        WHERE p0.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)
END AS "MinOfferPrice", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM seller_offers AS s3
    INNER JOIN sellers AS s4 ON s3.seller_id = s4.id
    WHERE p0.id = s3.product_id AND s3.is_active AND s4.status = 2 AND s4.is_active AND s3.stock - s3.reserved_count > 0) AS "OfferCount"
FROM (
    SELECT p.id, p.amazing_ends_at, p.category_id, p.discount_percent, p.english_name, p.is_amazing, p.is_special, p.main_image, p.name, p.reserved_count, p.sales_count, p.slug, p.stock, p.unit_price
    FROM products AS p
    WHERE p.is_active AND p.is_amazing AND p.stock - p.reserved_count > 0 AND p.discount_percent > 0
    ORDER BY p.discount_percent DESC
    LIMIT @p
) AS p0
INNER JOIN categories AS c ON p0.category_id = c.id
ORDER BY p0.discount_percent DESC

) r

FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q

) r

) r

    GROUP BY product_id
) r

FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q

) r

) r

commandText:
SELECT s.reservation_cleanup_interval_seconds
FROM site_settings AS s
ORDER BY s.id
LIMIT 1

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

SELECT p0.id AS "Id", p0.name AS "Name", p0.english_name AS "EnglishName", p0.slug AS "Slug", p0.main_image AS "Image", p0.unit_price AS "UnitPrice", CASE
    WHEN p0.discount_percent > 0 THEN p0.unit_price - (p0.unit_price * p0.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
    ELSE p0.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p0.stock - p0.reserved_count AS "Stock", p0.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p0.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p0.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p0.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c0
        WHERE p0.id = c0.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)
        FROM comments AS c1
        WHERE p0.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0
END AS "AverageRating", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c2
    WHERE p0.id = c2.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p0.sales_count AS "SalesCount", CASE

        SELECT 1
        FROM seller_offers AS s

        SELECT min(CASE

            ELSE s1.price
        END)
        FROM seller_offers AS s1
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s2 ON s1.seller_id = s2.id
        WHERE p0.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)

    SELECT count(*)::int

    WHERE p0.id = s3.product_id AND s3.is_active AND s4.status = 2 AND s4.is_active AND s3.stock - s3.reserved_count > 0) AS "OfferCount"
FROM (
    SELECT p.id, p.amazing_ends_at, p.category_id, p.discount_percent, p.english_name, p.is_amazing, p.is_special, p.main_image, p.name, p.reserved_count, p.sales_count, p.slug, p.stock, p.unit_price
    FROM products AS p
    WHERE p.is_active
    ORDER BY p.id DESC
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS p0
INNER JOIN categories AS c ON p0.category_id = c.id
ORDER BY p0.id DESC

SELECT s.reservation_cleanup_interval_seconds
FROM site_settings AS s
ORDER BY s.id
LIMIT 1

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

SELECT p0.id AS "Id", p0.name AS "Name", p0.english_name AS "EnglishName", p0.slug AS "Slug", p0.main_image AS "Image", p0.unit_price AS "UnitPrice", CASE
    WHEN p0.discount_percent > 0 THEN p0.unit_price - (p0.unit_price * p0.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
    ELSE p0.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p0.stock - p0.reserved_count AS "Stock", p0.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p0.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p0.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p0.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c0
        WHERE p0.id = c0.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)
        FROM comments AS c1
        WHERE p0.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0
END AS "AverageRating", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c2
    WHERE p0.id = c2.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p0.sales_count AS "SalesCount", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM seller_offers AS s
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s0 ON s.seller_id = s0.id
        WHERE p0.id = s.product_id AND s.is_active AND s0.status = 2 AND s0.is_active AND s.stock - s.reserved_count > 0) THEN (
        SELECT min(CASE
            WHEN s1.discount_percent > 0 THEN s1.price - (s1.price * s1.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
            ELSE s1.price
        END)
        FROM seller_offers AS s1
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s2 ON s1.seller_id = s2.id
        WHERE p0.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)
END AS "MinOfferPrice", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM seller_offers AS s3
    INNER JOIN sellers AS s4 ON s3.seller_id = s4.id
    WHERE p0.id = s3.product_id AND s3.is_active AND s4.status = 2 AND s4.is_active AND s3.stock - s3.reserved_count > 0) AS "OfferCount"
FROM (

    FROM products AS p
    WHERE p.is_active AND p.category_id = ANY (@ids)
    ORDER BY p.id DESC
    LIMIT @p2 OFFSET @p
) AS p0
INNER JOIN categories AS c ON p0.category_id = c.id
ORDER BY p0.id DESC

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()
SELECT 1

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

        FROM comments AS c1
        WHERE p0.id = c1.product_id)

    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c2
    WHERE p0.id = c2.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p0.sales_count AS "SalesCount", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM seller_offers AS s

        SELECT min(CASE

            ELSE s1.price
        END)

        WHERE p0.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)
END AS "MinOfferPrice", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM seller_offers AS s3
    INNER JOIN sellers AS s4 ON s3.seller_id = s4.id
    WHERE p0.id = s3.product_id AND s3.is_active AND s4.status = 2 AND s4.is_active AND s3.stock - s3.reserved_count > 0) AS "OfferCount"
FROM (
    SELECT p.id, p.amazing_ends_at, p.category_id, p.discount_percent, p.english_name, p.is_amazing, p.is_special, p.main_image, p.name, p.reserved_count, p.sales_count, p.slug, p.stock, p.unit_price
    FROM products AS p
    WHERE p.is_active
    ORDER BY p.id DESC
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS p0
INNER JOIN categories AS c ON p0.category_id = c.id
ORDER BY p0.id DESC

SELECT p0.id AS "Id", p0.name AS "Name", p0.english_name AS "EnglishName", p0.slug AS "Slug", p0.main_image AS "Image", p0.unit_price AS "UnitPrice", CASE
    WHEN p0.discount_percent > 0 THEN p0.unit_price - (p0.unit_price * p0.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
    ELSE p0.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p0.stock - p0.reserved_count AS "Stock", p0.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p0.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p0.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p0.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c0
        WHERE p0.id = c0.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)
        FROM comments AS c1
        WHERE p0.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0
END AS "AverageRating", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c2
    WHERE p0.id = c2.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p0.sales_count AS "SalesCount", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM seller_offers AS s
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s0 ON s.seller_id = s0.id
        WHERE p0.id = s.product_id AND s.is_active AND s0.status = 2 AND s0.is_active AND s.stock - s.reserved_count > 0) THEN (
        SELECT min(CASE
            WHEN s1.discount_percent > 0 THEN s1.price - (s1.price * s1.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
            ELSE s1.price
        END)
        FROM seller_offers AS s1
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s2 ON s1.seller_id = s2.id
        WHERE p0.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)
END AS "MinOfferPrice", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM seller_offers AS s3
    INNER JOIN sellers AS s4 ON s3.seller_id = s4.id
    WHERE p0.id = s3.product_id AND s3.is_active AND s4.status = 2 AND s4.is_active AND s3.stock - s3.reserved_count > 0) AS "OfferCount"
FROM (
    SELECT p.id, p.amazing_ends_at, p.category_id, p.discount_percent, p.english_name, p.is_amazing, p.is_special, p.main_image, p.name, p.reserved_count, p.sales_count, p.slug, p.stock, p.unit_price
    FROM products AS p
    WHERE p.is_active AND p.is_amazing AND p.stock - p.reserved_count > 0 AND p.discount_percent > 0
    ORDER BY p.discount_percent DESC

    WHEN p0.discount_percent > 0 THEN p0.unit_price - (p0.unit_price * p0.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
    ELSE p0.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p0.stock - p0.reserved_count AS "Stock", p0.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p0.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p0.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p0.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", b.name AS "BrandName", b.slug AS "BrandSlug", p0.attributes_json AS "AttributesJson", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c0
        WHERE p0.id = c0.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)
        FROM comments AS c1
        WHERE p0.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0
END AS "AverageRating", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c2
    WHERE p0.id = c2.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p0.sales_count AS "SalesCount", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM seller_offers AS s
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s0 ON s.seller_id = s0.id
        WHERE p0.id = s.product_id AND s.is_active AND s0.status = 2 AND s0.is_active AND s.stock - s.reserved_count > 0) THEN (

            WHEN s1.discount_percent > 0 THEN s1.price - (s1.price * s1.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
            ELSE s1.price
        END)

        INNER JOIN sellers AS s2 ON s1.seller_id = s2.id
        WHERE p0.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

        INNER JOIN sellers AS s2 ON s1.seller_id = s2.id
        WHERE p0.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)
END AS "MinOfferPrice", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM seller_offers AS s3
    INNER JOIN sellers AS s4 ON s3.seller_id = s4.id
    WHERE p0.id = s3.product_id AND s3.is_active AND s4.status = 2 AND s4.is_active AND s3.stock - s3.reserved_count > 0) AS "OfferCount"

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations

    ELSE p0.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p0.stock - p0.reserved_count AS "Stock", p0.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p0.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p0.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p0.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", b.name AS "BrandName", b.slug AS "BrandSlug", p0.attributes_json AS "AttributesJson", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c0
        WHERE p0.id = c0.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)
        FROM comments AS c1
        WHERE p0.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0
END AS "AverageRating", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c2
    WHERE p0.id = c2.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p0.sales_count AS "SalesCount", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM seller_offers AS s
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s0 ON s.seller_id = s0.id
        WHERE p0.id = s.product_id AND s.is_active AND s0.status = 2 AND s0.is_active AND s.stock - s.reserved_count > 0) THEN (
        SELECT min(CASE
            WHEN s1.discount_percent > 0 THEN s1.price - (s1.price * s1.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
            ELSE s1.price
        END)
        FROM seller_offers AS s1
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s2 ON s1.seller_id = s2.id
        WHERE p0.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)
END AS "MinOfferPrice", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM seller_offers AS s3
    INNER JOIN sellers AS s4 ON s3.seller_id = s4.id
    WHERE p0.id = s3.product_id AND s3.is_active AND s4.status = 2 AND s4.is_active AND s3.stock - s3.reserved_count > 0) AS "OfferCount"
FROM (
    SELECT p.id, p.amazing_ends_at, p.attributes_json, p.brand_id, p.category_id, p.discount_percent, p.english_name, p.is_amazing, p.is_special, p.main_image, p.name, p.reserved_count, p.sales_count, p.slug, p.stock, p.unit_price
    FROM products AS p
    WHERE p.is_active AND p.id <> @productId AND p.category_id = @categoryId AND p.stock - p.reserved_count > 0
    ORDER BY p.sales_count DESC
    LIMIT @p
) AS p0
INNER JOIN categories AS c ON p0.category_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN brands AS b ON p0.brand_id = b.id
ORDER BY p0.sales_count DESC

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q

    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()

) r

SELECT s.reservation_cleanup_interval_seconds
FROM site_settings AS s
ORDER BY s.id
LIMIT 1

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

    ELSE p0.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p0.stock - p0.reserved_count AS "Stock", p0.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p0.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p0.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p0.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", b.name AS "BrandName", b.slug AS "BrandSlug", p0.attributes_json AS "AttributesJson", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c0

        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)

        WHERE p0.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0

    SELECT count(*)::int

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
